# seqera_service_account (Data Source)

Look up an organization service account by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service account to look up.
- `org_id` (Number) Organization numeric identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description of the service account.
- `id` (Number) Service account numeric identifier. Use it as `seqera_agent.service_account_id`.
- `member_id` (Number) Organization membership identifier. Use it as `seqera_workspace_participant.member_id`.
